implementation.homepage: fixed /wecom/yixiaoxiu/ keeps bounded OAuth delegation until MEMBER_SELF_SERVICE and both flags are present
implementation.native_http: same-origin native HTML, CSS and JavaScript routes for new report, my reports, detail, timeline, supplement, command recovery and logout
implementation.form: plain-language description/location/unknown/impact form; location must be supplied or explicitly marked unknown; no technical classification gate or patient data field
implementation.writes: 202 Accepted carries the real request_ref location; no optimistic Ticket number; command and supplement POSTs keep backend idempotency and CSRF boundaries
implementation.read_model: Web and member-owned Bot rows stay behind existing query authorization and Unified Ticket Core; detail exposes bounded safe supplement text
implementation.client_safety: one in-flight fetch, visible-page five-second detail polling, hidden/pagehide abort and generation fences, ETag accepted only after detail plus timeline, textContent-only rendering, opaque bounded pending command id only
implementation.readonly: factory accepts only MEMBER_SELF_SERVICE or FULL_SERVICE_LOOP; MEMBER_TICKET_READONLY remains outside the write surface

acceptance_cases.coverage: fixed homepage serves native UI only for enabled self-service profile and otherwise delegates the existing authentication prompt
browser form exposes description, location/unknown, optional service, impact, department and extension without requiring technical classification
duplicate submit events are fenced, HTTP returns 202, and the UI navigates to the real request reference without inventing a Ticket
isolated HTTP assertions cover 401, 403, 409 and native status mapping including 503/429 copy
two isolated browser sessions use separate member cookies and receive separate request references/list rows
logout/pagehide clear sensitive DOM state, abort fetches and handle BFCache pageshow with a fresh bootstrap
source and browser checks cover one in-flight request, visibility/pagehide stop, five-second schedule and post-timeline ETag update
malicious safe_description remains text and no element/event handler is created; source has no innerHTML/outerHTML/eval
Chromium checks at 390x844 and 1440x900 confirm no horizontal overflow, labels and keyboard focus
sessionStorage is limited to a versioned opaque UUID pending command record; no body, CSRF, cookie or raw identity is stored

validation.result: 2 passed with isolated native HTTP and Chromium browser
4 passed with isolated PostgreSQL; one transient 498/500 mixed snapshot rerun passed
1 passed, 1 intentional database test skipped without an explicit integration invocation

side_effects: No real OAuth, WeCom SDK, production database, Bot message, chat Session, Direct Leg, notification, SSH, cloud publish or external send was used.
rollback: Keep YIXIAOXIU_SELF_SERVICE_ENABLED=false or YIXIAOXIU_MY_REPORTS_ENABLED=false; the native handler delegates the fixed homepage to the existing bounded authentication surface and does not remove accepted facts.
next_gate: SS-008 must wire this native surface to real local DB/HTTP/rule/manual-review assembly before any live readiness claim.
